description: This file provides a Python API wrapper for managing UWP (Universal Windows Platform) applications and packages, including functions for listing, installing, removing, and controlling UWP apps via PowerShell scripts and subprocess calls. It also includes an interactive command-line interface for user interaction.

classes.name: UwpApi
classes.description: A wrapper class for managing UWP applications and packages on Windows 10, providing methods to list, install, remove, and control apps and packages.

methods.name: ExecutePowershellScript
methods.description: Executes a PowerShell script with optional arguments and returns its output.

methods.name: GetPackageDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for a given UWP package full name.

methods.name: GetPackageAppMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping of package names to their applications, filtered by package and app name.

methods.name: GetRunningProcessMap
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of process IDs to process names, filtered by executable name.

methods.name: RemoveSuffix
methods.description: Removes a specified suffix from a string if present.
